record.name: CoHear - AI Meeting Note Taker
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
CoHear – Your AI Note Taking App for Every Important Conversation!

Whether you're a busy professional, entrepreneur, salesperson, recruiter, consultant, or keeping track of important conversations with your doctor, CoHear helps you capture every detail without interrupting the moment.

Stay fully present while CoHear records, transcribes, and transforms conversations into organized notes with summaries, key decisions, and action items. Perfect for meetings, client calls, interviews, medical appointments, brainstorming sessions, conferences, and everyday conversations.

Stay Present. CoHear Takes the Notes
Stop worrying about missing a detail.
Simply tap Record, import an audio or video file, or capture a conversation on the go. CoHear automatically transcribes speech to text with high accuracy, identifies different speakers, and preserves the entire conversation—so you can focus on listening instead of typing.

What you can do:
-Record meetings, interviews, doctor visits, coffee chats & personal notes.
-Import existing audio and video files for transcription.
-Get AI notes for recordings & audios
-Accurate AI transcription with speaker recognition.

Smart Notes, Not Just Transcripts
A transcript tells you what was said. CoHear tells you what matters.
Instead of reading pages of transcripts, get structured AI-generated notes in minutes.

Every summary includes:
-Key discussion points
-Important decisions
-Action items
-Task owners
-Next steps
Whether it's a client meeting, sales call, interview, or project discussion, CoHear helps you find what matters instantly.

Built for the Way You Work
CoHear understands different professions and meeting scenarios.
Ideal for:
Business professionals managing daily meetings
Entrepreneurs and small business owners
Sales teams tracking customer conversations
Recruiters conducting interviews
Product, HR, Operations, and Customer Success teams
Patients keeping track of medical advice and treatment plans

From team stand-ups and customer meetings to conference sessions and doctor's appointments, CoHear helps you stay organized wherever important conversations happen.

Keep everyone aligned without extra work
-Turn conversations into polished notes everyone can understand.
-Generate presentation-ready summaries
-Share notes with teammates, clients, or friends in one tap

Save Hours Every Week
Skip the manual note-taking and hours of reviewing recordings.
CoHear automatically transforms long conversations into concise, actionable notes, helping you remember every detail and follow up with confidence.

Private by Design
Your recordings and notes are protected with encrypted storage and secure data transmission. You stay in control of your data and can manage or delete your recordings whenever you want.

AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTIONS
CoHear offers the following monthly auto-renewable subscriptions:
Meeting Plus: US$14.99/month
Meeting Pro: US$29.99/month
Creator Plus: US$28.99/month
Creator Pro: US$49.99/month
Plans include monthly recording minutes, file imports, and AI Inspiration for AI features such as presentations and infographics. Subscription allowances reset at the start of each billing period and do not carry over.

Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account's Subscriptions settings. record.description_evidence:
Viska is the #1 offline voice transcription app powered by Whisper AI. Record or import meetings, voice memos, interviews, and lectures—then transcribe them 100% on-device in 11 languages. No internet required.

Turn your meetings, lectures, interviews, and voice notes into clear text—completely offline. Viska can now separate transcripts by speaker, so conversations are easier to follow. Rename Speaker 1, Speaker 2, and other labels to real names, then chat with your transcripts using powerful local AI. Zero data leaves your device.

NOW WITH MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT

Transcribe in English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Hungarian, Chinese, and Hindi—all processed locally on your device. No cloud transcription services. No data sent anywhere. Just accurate, private transcription in your language.

WHY VISKA?

Most AI transcribers upload your private conversations to the cloud. Viska is different. We bring the AI to you. Whether you're discussing trade secrets, signed NDAs, patient data, client notes, interviews, or personal ideas, your audio never touches a server.

KEY FEATURES

• Local AI Transcription — Get accurate, fast transcripts using advanced Whisper technology running directly on your phone. No internet required.

• Speaker Diarization — Automatically separate conversations by speaker with labels like Speaker 1 and Speaker 2, then rename speakers for cleaner meeting notes, interviews, and lecture transcripts.

• 11 Languages — English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Hungarian, Chinese, and Hindi. All on-device.

• Import Audio Files — Import existing MP3, WAV, and M4A recordings for instant transcription. Voice memos, interview recordings, podcast episodes—drop them in and get text back. All processed locally.

• Chat with Your Audio — Ask questions like “What were the action items?” or “Summarize the key points.” Our on-device AI analyzes your text instantly to give you answers.

• Ironclad Privacy

• No Servers: We don't have a cloud. We can't see your data even if we wanted to.
• Encrypted Storage: All transcripts and chats are stored in a secure, encrypted local database.
• You Own It: Export your text, delete your files, manage your storage. It's your data.

• Organize & Export — Search through all your past meetings instantly. Export transcripts.

PERFECT FOR

• Executives & Boards — Securely record sensitive strategy meetings
• Doctors & Lawyers — Dictate notes without violating client confidentiality
• Journalists — Protect your sources with on-device processing
• Podcasters & Interviewers — Import recordings and get searchable speaker-labeled transcripts
• Students — Record lectures and keep each speaker easier to follow
• International Teams — Transcribe meetings in 11 languages without cloud services

One-Time Purchase. No Subscriptions.

Stop renting your privacy. Buy Viska once and own your AI transcription assistant forever.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Easily transform voice notes into any format. Go for a walk, think aloud, and have your notes summarized. Or write a long, professional email from a single spoken sentence.
With Superwhisper, you write up to 5x faster using your voice. Accurate transcription, clean punctuation, and AI formatting. All hands-free.

HOW IT WORKS
Hold to record. Release to paste. Your words come out as polished text in whatever app you're using. Emails sound like emails. Slack messages stay casual. Code prompts stay technical. You don't configure any of this. The AI figures it out from the context on your screen.

USE IT FOR
Emails you'd normally spend ten minutes drafting
Meeting notes and voice memos you'll actually reread
Messages in ChatGPT, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Notes, or any other app
Long-form writing that starts as a five-minute ramble
Capture in 100+ languages, with optional translation to English

NEW IN 2.0
A shortcut to start dictating anywhere, on demand
Redesigned interface
Switch modes directly from the keyboard
Search your full recording history
Bring your own API keys
Create custom presets that match exactly how you write

CUSTOM MODES
Define a mode once, use it forever. A casual mode for messages, a formal one for client emails, a technical one for code prompts. Each mode formats your speech to match the context so your words land the right way every time.

PRIVACY
Recordings and transcripts stay on your device. Use BYOK mode to route AI processing through providers you already trust.

Referat records your meetings and lectures, transcribes them, works out who said what, and writes a summary with action items. Free. No ads. No subscription, no account and no minute limits – and your audio never leaves your iPhone.

RECORD WITH ONE TAP
• One big red button. Recording continues when you lock your phone
• See the time on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Pause, and mark important moments as you go
• Import audio from Files, Voice Memos or the Share menu – video too

TRANSCRIPTS IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
• English, Danish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean – Referat detects the language itself
• Speech becomes text right on your phone with Whisper
• Referat finds the different speakers – name them with a tap
• Tap a word to hear that moment again, and play at 0.5–2× speed
• Search one recording or all of them

SUMMARY AND ACTION ITEMS

SHARE IT YOUR WAY

YOUR MEETINGS ARE YOURS

FREE. JUST ENJOY IT.

Remember to tell everyone in the meeting that you are recording.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
LocalScribe turns conversations into structured notes — privately.

Record any meeting, lecture, interview, or thought. LocalScribe transcribes it and writes a clean, organized summary with sections, decisions, and action items.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT. The free tier runs 100% on your device — audio, transcription, summaries, and chat all stay on the Neural Engine using Apple's iOS 26 speech engine and Apple Intelligence. No accounts, no analytics, no upload.

PREMIUM — TWO TIERS. For top accuracy in noisy rooms and tough accents, Premium adds cloud transcription (Deepgram Nova-3) and richer summaries (Claude Opus 4.8, with GPT-4o for everyday formats):
• Starter — $14.99/month, 10 hours of cloud features
• Pro — $34.99/month, 30 hours of cloud features
On Premium, audio is sent to Deepgram for transcription and the transcript text is sent to Anthropic (and, for some formats, OpenAI) for the summary — none of these providers train on your data. Want a sensitive recording to stay fully on-device? Flip the per-recording "No-Cloud" toggle and it never leaves your phone.

MANY SUMMARY STYLES — pick what fits your recording:
• Clean Summary, Meeting Minutes, Executive Summary
• Action-Item Summary, Decision Log, Follow-Up Email Draft
• Q&A Format, Speaker-Labeled summaries, Timeline Notes
• Study Notes and Flashcards (for students)
• Clinical and behavioral-health note formats (drafts for licensed clinicians to review)
• Word-for-Word Verbatim — plus templates for sales, legal, healthcare, teaching, and research.

20 LANGUAGES — English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Polish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Swedish.

CHAT WITH YOUR RECORDINGS. Ask "what did Sarah decide about the deadline?" — the AI reads the transcript and answers.

SPEAKER LABELS. LocalScribe works out who's speaking and lets you tap a label to assign real names — corrected everywhere at once.

REFERENCES & DIAGRAMS. Tap "Add References" and LocalScribe surfaces verified Wikipedia links for the things your recording mentioned, plus timeline and process diagrams drawn from the summary.

CALENDAR INTEGRATION. See your upcoming meetings; tap one to start a recording auto-tagged with the title and attendees.

EXPORT ANYWHERE. Share as Markdown, formatted PDF, editable Word (.rtf), or plain text. AirPrint supported. PDFs auto-mirror to iCloud Drive.

WORKS ACROSS YOUR DEVICES. iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with an Apple Watch remote to start and stop recordings from your wrist. Recordings sync via iCloud, end-to-end encrypted by Apple.

PRIVACY PROMISE:
• Free tier: recording, transcription, summaries, and chat are always on-device.
• Premium cloud features: audio is sent to Deepgram for transcription; transcript text is sent to Anthropic (Claude) and, for some summary formats, OpenAI (GPT-4o). None of these providers train on your data. The per-recording No-Cloud toggle keeps any recording fully on-device.
• No analytics SDKs. No ads. No data brokers. No accounts.

Free tier: 5 recordings per month, or 60 minutes of audio — whichever comes first. Resets on the 1st of each month.

Premium: Starter $14.99/month (10 hours of cloud features) or Pro $34.99/month (30 hours). Cancel anytime through iOS Settings.

Perfect for lawyers, therapists, clinicians, real-estate agents, sales teams, students, journalists, and researchers.

Requires iOS 26. AI summaries and chat require a device that supports Apple Intelligence; recording and transcription work on any iOS 26 device.

Privacy Policy: https://localscribe.net/privacy

record.name: After Call — AI Meeting Notes
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
After Call transforms every conversation into actionable intelligence. Record meetings, calls, and interviews with one tap — then let After Call do the rest.

KNOWS WHO'S SPEAKING
After Call's rebuilt voice recognition engine learns your voice with a simple 90-second setup. After that, you're automatically identified in every meeting. The app recognizes frequent collaborators over time — no manual labeling, no training required. The more you use it, the smarter it gets.

Voice profiles are stored securely on your device and never uploaded. Your voice data stays private.

ACCURATE TRANSCRIPTION WITH SPEAKER LABELS
Get word-for-word transcriptions with speaker attribution automatically applied. Review and confirm speakers after each recording with confidence indicators showing high, medium, and low-confidence matches. Edit any transcript inline — fix a misheard word in seconds.

AI NOTES THAT ADAPT TO YOUR WORK
Choose your AI Lens — Sales, Operations, Technical, or Simple — and After Call generates notes in the format that fits how you work. Action items are extracted automatically with owners and due dates.

SALES INTELLIGENCE (PRO)
Built for sales professionals. After Call detects objections, buying signals, competitor mentions, and pricing discussions across your sales conversations. Track deal health, spot objection patterns, and see engagement trends — all without lifting a finger. Set your AI Lens to Sales to unlock the full intelligence layer.

THE EMOTIONAL MEMORY LAYER
See how energy flows through your meetings with the Vibe Timeline — a visual map of engagement, pace, and momentum across every conversation. Build communication profiles for every person in your network. Post-call insights help you become a better communicator, processed entirely on your device.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
After Call is built on a simple principle: your data belongs to you. Voice profiles never leave your device. Transcription uses OpenAI's API with strict data handling — audio is deleted from their servers after processing and never used for training. Nothing is sold. Nothing is shared with advertisers.

DESIGNED FOR PROFESSIONALS
— One-tap recording with Live Activity on your Lock Screen
— Try free as a guest — no account required, recordings transfer when you sign up
— Collapsible meeting detail — more space for what matters
— Full transcripts in every share link
— CRM export (Pro)
— Calendar integration for automatic meeting context
— iCloud sync across your devices

Every conversation contains signals most people miss — buying intent, objection patterns, engagement shifts, relationship momentum. The free plan gives you transcription and AI notes to get started. Pro gives you everything: unlimited recordings, Sales Intelligence, all eight AI Lenses, CRM export, and the Emotional Memory Layer. For the people whose livelihood depends on reading the room.

record.description_evidence:
Your Meetings, Captured. Your Focus, Uninterrupted.

Tired of juggling notes while trying to lead a conversation? Meet Notica - your AI-powered meeting sidekick that listens, understands, and turns every discussion into clean, structured notes. Whether you're in an online meeting, in-person conversation, or reviewing old audio files, Notica captures everything and organizes it automatically.

Stop wrestling with messy notes - Notica transforms chaos into clarity with accurate transcripts, smart summaries, and effortless organization.

5 Reasons Why Professionals Choose Notica
• Non real-time transcripts that turn chaos into clear, structured notes
• Smart summaries capturing decisions, next steps & action items
• Google Calendar sync so every prep step happens automatically
• Ask AI anything about your past meetings with Notica AI assistant
• Your conversations stay private with enterprise-grade security
• Auto bot joins meetings and takes notes for you—hands-free

Key Features of Notica – Your AI Meeting Assistant
• Auto Bot Join Meeting
Let Notica join your Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams meetings automatically - even if you're busy or away. The bot listens, captures the conversation, generates transcripts, and produces summaries so you never miss important information again.

• Upload Audio Files → Instant Transcript & Summary
Already have recordings? Simply upload your audio and let Notica generate:
– Full transcript
– Key highlights
– Action items
– Structured meeting summary
Perfect for interviews, lectures, brainstorming sessions, podcasts, and offline meetings.

• Smart Recording
Record in-person meetings with high-quality audio - professionally captured, clean, and ready for AI analysis.

• Non Real-Time Transcription (NEW)
Notica processes your recordings after the meeting to deliver accurate transcripts without requiring live connection or real-time processing.

• AI-Powered Summarization
Save hours of manual work. Notica automatically highlights main ideas, decisions, follow-ups, and structured outlines.

• Notica AI Chat Assistant
Ask anything:
“Show me all tasks from last week’s meetings.”
“What decisions were made in Client A call?”
“Summarize all conversations about Q1 goals.”
Notica understands your meetings and gives instant answers.

• Google Calendar Integration
Your meetings auto-sync so Notica always knows what’s next. Prep notes, join links, and reminders—everything is ready before the call begins.

• Export & Share
Export transcripts, audio, or summaries in multiple formats for easy sharing with teams or clients.

• Smart Note Management

Organize transcripts using folders. Quickly search for keywords across all past conversations.

• Privacy First
Your data stays yours.
Notica uses end-to-end encryption and never shares, sells, or uses your recordings for any external purpose. You control what to export, share, or delete—anytime.

• Hands-Free & Distraction-Free
Stay fully present in conversations. Let Notica document everything in the background so you can participate naturally and confidently.

The Smarter Way to Stay Engaged
No more splitting attention between listening and note-taking. Notica gives you clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind—all effortlessly.

Elevate your productivity and transform your meetings with Notica today!

• Subscription options: monthly and yearly
• Payment is charged at purchase confirmation
• Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings
• Auto-renews unless turned off 24 hours before renewal
• No refunds for unused subscription time
• Unused free trial periods are forfeited upon subscription

Perfect for students, consultants, executives, lawyers, and other professionals aiming to achieve more in less time, this app effortlessly boosts productivity. It combines advanced text and voice recognition to instantly record, transcribe audio to text, translate, and edit any speech. Revolutionize the way you capture and organize information with FoxNote - AI Note Taker!

Designed specifically for the needs of adults with ADHD, FoxNote simplifies their daily routines, enhances focus, and helps bring order to chaos. Whether it’s converting voice to notes, structuring ideas, or keeping track of important details, this app is expertly crafted to tackle the challenges of ADHD, making productivity feel effortless.

FoxNote transcribes all your meetings, interviews, lectures, and everyday voice conversations in real time, so you can focus on what matters while the app takes care of the rest. Or make a transcript from video using the YouTube Summary feature—simply paste the link to gain instant insights.

WHY USERS LOVE FOXNOTE
- Speech to Text: Instantly record and transcribe voice memos into clear, organized notes—perfect on the go or during meetings.
- AI Flashcards: Grasp concepts faster and more effectively with concise flashcards.
- Quiz Maker: Prepare for exams or presentations in a fun, interactive way.
- YouTube Summary: Transcribe video to text and get its short-form summary in a matter of seconds.
- Smart Structuring: Capture key points during lectures or meetings, edit and organize your notes.
- Offline Accessibility: Take notes anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.

MORE AI SUPERPOWERS
- Text Summarization: Save time and grasp the essence of long texts.
- Proofreading: Create polished, error-free notes without the hassle.
- Real-Time Translation: Break barriers by translating your content into multiple languages.
- Quick Sharing: Seamlessly share notes with friends, family, or colleagues.
- ADHD-Friendly: Stay organized and manage tasks effortlessly with smart AI tools.

Forget the hassle of manual meeting note taking! With its powerful AI for meetings, FoxNote ensures every detail is captured and organized, making it the ultimate tool for keeping track of important discussions and decisions.
